# LiveServerSessionResumptionUpdate

common

@[Serializable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/kotlinx.serialization/kotlinx-serialization-core/kotlinx.serialization/-serializable/index.html)

data class [LiveServerSessionResumptionUpdate](index.html)(val newHandle: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)? = null, val resumable: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null, val lastConsumedClientMessageIndex: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)? = null)

A handle for resuming this session on a later connection.

Sent only when session resumption is requested. The handle arrives at points of the server's choosing, including after a turn has completed, so a reader that stops at the end of a turn can miss it.
